items.title: Airlines Can’t Upgrade Every Plane – So They’re Upgrading the Menu
items.snippet: Skift Take: New cabins are expensive, complicated, and slow to arrive. Celebrity chefs? A faster way to serve up an upscale experience — and help justify the premium fare. Airlines are turning to celebrity chefs to give their premium cabins a makeover without having to replace a single seat.

items.title: OTOAI and Israel Tourism Ministry sign MoU in Mumbai
items.snippet: The Outbound Tour Operators Association of India (OTOAI) and the Israel Ministry of Tourism (IMOT) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) in Mumbai to strengthen tourism cooperation, increase destination awareness and explore new collaboration opportunities between Israel and India’s outbound travel industry. The agreement was signed on October 16, 2026.

items.title: Connaught Place restaurant owner moves Delhi HC against protests; seeks compensation
items.snippet: A restaurant owner in Connaught Place has approached the Delhi High Court seeking directions to the authorities not to grant permission for unauthorised protests, demonstrations or assemblies in the commercial hub that could cause financial losses to traders.

items.title: redBus launches new campaign showcasing changing bus travel experiences
items.snippet: Online bus ticketing platform redBus has launched a new brand campaign, ‘Bus Travel Ka Tareeka Badal Raha Hai’, highlighting how evolving travel features are transforming the bus journey experience. The campaign focuses on changing expectations among younger travellers, particularly Gen Z, who increasingly seek greater choice, convenience, control and confidence when planning their journeys.

items.title: India’s MICE sector poised for significant growth
items.snippet: India’s Meetings, Incentives, Conferences and Exhibitions (MICE) sector has significant headroom for expansion, with Maharashtra emerging as the first state in the country to establish a dedicated MICE convention promotion bureau. Mumbai is also positioning itself as a global MICE destination, supported by growing infrastructure and stronger government-industry collaboration.

items.title: Spree Hospitality achieves net promoter score of 96 in Q2 and 95 in H1 FY27
items.snippet: The achievement reinforces Spree’s belief that growth goes beyond adding properties. As its footprint expands, the company remains focused on excelling in operations, ensuring guest happiness and living its philosophy of DO MORE through meaningful moments of truth at every stage of a guest’s stay, said a release.

items.title: IRCTC launches wildlife tour packages in Maharashtra
items.snippet: The Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC) has partnered with the Maharashtra Forest Department to introduce wildlife tour packages covering Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve and Pench Tiger Reserve. The initiative aims to make wildlife tourism more convenient by combining rail travel, accommodation, local transport and safari permits into a single package.

items.title: Hunger Pangs Limited who own Burma Burma Restaurants files DRHP with SEBI
items.snippet: The offer comprises a fresh issue of equity shares of face value of Rs 2 each aggregating up to Rs 150 crore (the fresh issue) and an offer for sale of up to 27,929,760 equity shares of face value of Rs 2 each by the Selling Shareholders.

items.title: FSSAI issues notices to Radisson Blu Delhi operator, Flipkart and BigBasket over food safety violations
items.snippet: Food regulator Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) on Friday said that it has issued notices to the operator of Radisson Blu Hotel here and e-commerce majors Flipkart and BigBasket over misleading claims for an edible oil, among other enforcement actions this week.
